experiments_note: EXPERIMENTS TO PLAY on launch night (PR 26), one per story format. Each says what to do, what must be on screen so the Short can prove it (the HUD visible, the camera on it, wait for the result), and a library.py query that finds it after indexing. F1 also lists the GTA 5 footage the library already has for the same topic. Nothing here is a fact about GTA 6.

experiments.try: Get 2-3 wanted stars, get out, take a different car in view of the camera, drive off; keep going until the stars are gone (or 60 s)
experiments.proof: the stars on the HUD the whole time; the car swap on camera; the moment the stars go

experiments.try: Get 1-2 stars, change outfit (a store or the wardrobe if the game allows it mid-chase), walk out and stand still for 20 s
experiments.proof: the stars before and after; the new outfit on camera; menus are never used, so show the walk out

experiments.try: Get 2 stars near water, jump or drive in, stay under or swim away from the shore
experiments.proof: the stars on the HUD, the water, the stars going (or not)

experiments.try: Your first drive: get the camera behind the car for 15 s on an open road, then a slow turn
experiments.proof: the car and the road clearly in view, no menus

experiments.try: Your first wanted level in a car: keep the chase going 30 s with the police in the picture
experiments.proof: stars on the HUD, police cars in view

experiments.try: Your first time at the beach: walk onto the sand, turn the camera slowly across the water and the skyline
experiments.proof: a slow, clear view: sand, water, people, buildings

experiments.try: Your first Jason/Lucia switch: before it, stand still for 3 s; after it, 10 s of the other character in view
experiments.proof: both characters before and after (the switch screen itself is never used)

experiments.try: A chase at 3+ stars with the police cars in view for 15 s
experiments.proof: the police cars and the stars, so they can be set beside GTA 5's
